jobs.title: E & I Technician
jobs.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.
We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans.
At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.
Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas suppliers, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project.
For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households.
What you’ll do:
Based in Gobe, PNG, the E&I Technician maintains and troubleshoots Process Control Instrumentation across Well Heads, Processing Plants, remote communication sites, Valve Stations, and the Kumul Marine Terminal.
You’ll work closely with Production and engineering teams to support daily production targets and provide technical support to contractors on operational and HSES matters.
This is a 28:28 FIFO role.
Key Responsibilities
Troubleshoot and repair breakdowns on all instruments and electrical equipment using proven techniques to identify and fix faults.
Provide training and mentorship to junior local instrument technicians to build their skills and ensure successful task completion.
Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair gas-fired equipment across the project.
Install, troubleshoot, and repair various oil and gas meters, including hardware repairs, meter configuration, calibration, and security.
Verify and monitor programmable logic controllers (PLCs), adjust programs, troubleshoot event sequences, and reprogram as needed.
Assist the instrumentation system administrator with programming, maintenance, and repairs of the distributed control system.
Plan and conduct preventative maintenance inspections on all instrumentation equipment, coordinating schedules and documenting findings.
Troubleshoot and maintain ESD, smoke, thermal, and gas detection systems, performing functional tests and fault isolation.
Install new instrumentation equipment, including detailed layouts, point-to-point drawings, material procurement, installation, and commissioning.
Ensure compliance with Santos Management System (SMS), Delegation of Authority (DOA), and Corporate Governance and Safety standards.
What you’ll bring:
Proven experience as an Instrument Technician in a similar industry, demonstrating practical skills and knowledge relevant to the role.
Practical knowledge of basic instrumentation and process control.
Experience working in Oil & Gas or Mining industries, familiar with plant processes and equipment.
Competent in repair, installation, and calibration of Process Control Instrumentation.
Ability to read, understand and interpret basic Instrument/Electrical and pneumatic loop drawings.
Familiarity with Distributed Control Systems (DCS).
Ideally, you’ll hold an Electronics or Instrumentation Trade Certificate or be a Licensed Electrician cross-trained as an Instrument Technician with relevant certification.
What you’ll get:
Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.
At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.
Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.
What you’re part of:
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose  - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before
COB 5
th
November 2025.
A requirement of this role is that you will need to have in place the legal work rights for PNG to apply.
Potential Scams
There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place.  You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is
https://recruitment.santos.com/

jobs.description:

JOB VACANCY ANNOUNCEMENT
POSITION TITLE:
DRIVER
MSF BACKGROUND
Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders)
is a private, non-profit international humanitarian organization founded in 1971 and operating in 70 countries worldwide. MSF delivers medical assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, natural disasters, and exclusion from health care. MSF aids people based on need, irrespective of race, religion, gender, or political affiliation.
PROJECT CONTEXT
In PNG, MSF has been working since 2007 in Lae, Tari, Bougainville, Gulf Province, and NCD Province. In 2024, MSF started a new project in Jiwaka province to enhance access to care for survivors of violence in Jiwaka province and is now working to support the Department of Health to improve access to care for patients in JIWAKA and the Highlands.
General Role
Performing the tasks of transporting authorized goods and passengers in an MSF vehicle, ensuring its technical and safety conditions, and respecting the country's traffic rules and MSF security rules, to provide a safe, smooth and efficient service.
Main Accountability
Checking daily, the technical conditions of the assigned vehicle (state of the tires, oil, fuel, brakes, radio equipment, spare parts, etc.), performing weekly checks according to the MSF Logbook, refilling it when necessary, and keeping it clean to ensure it can be driven in perfect condition. Ensuring all passengers have all necessary papers in order before travelling, and ensuring non-MSF staff sign disclaimers of responsibility before using the vehicle

Informing the line manager of any incident involving the transportation of passengers and/or goods.
Knowing how to use all types of radios, codes, call numbers, and radio alphabets by heart and communicating with base according to MSF communications policy to inform the driver's position and any potential implications.
Knowing and respecting the security rules related to vehicle movements, specifically those related to customs, checkpoints, and roadblocks. Ensuring all passengers know and respect the security rules

VEHICLE CHECKS/MAINTENANCE

TRANSPORTATION OF MATERIALS

Ensure correct loading and unloading of the vehicle, in particular:
SAFETY & SECURITY

Ensure that vehicles seat belts are functional and visible for passengers to use.

Inform the line manager of any incident involving the transportation of passengers or goods.

Essential knowledge of basic mechanics
Desirable in MSF or other NGOs

jobs.title: Graduate Field Coordinator
jobs.description:
Tebbutt Research PNG - Graduate Field Coordinator
Are you a young professional looking for an exciting and challenging career in the market and social research industry with a regional market leader and internationally recognised firm?
Do you have a degree qualification from a recognised university?
Do you have up to 2 years of commercial work experience?
Are you a motivated team player?
If this sounds like you, then you might be the person we are looking for!
The Company
Tebbutt Research is an ISO-20252-certified business that specialises in market and social research. We have been established for over 30 years and our clients include prominent multinational corporations, respected donor organizations and governments. We are the industry leader in the Pacific Islands, where we work across 22 countries. We have won numerous awards over the years and have a great, close-knit team and a supportive work culture.
Research fields include customer satisfaction, ad and communications testing, brand development, media ratings, segmentation studies, product testing, and monitoring and evaluation surveys. The techniques used include qualitative research, quantitative research, data analysis, observation, and audit methods.
The Role
We now have an opportunity for a professional to join our small executive team in Port Moresby as Graduate Field Coordinator. This role covers a range of project and people tasks both in the office and in the field, including:
coordination of our fieldwork teams of interviewers, including running project briefings, conducting field visits, monitoring team progress, and planning logistics
providing accurate and timely reporting on fieldwork status to the field management team
following our fieldwork compliance requirements for ISO using our existing procedures
regular travel domestically in PNG to conduct small team briefings and check on team progress
checking questionnaire scripts that are programmed onto tablet devices by our data team to see that they work correctly before running briefings with the fieldwork team
supporting the PNG General Manager as required
The role suits a person with flexibility in working hours, including work into early evenings and on weekends as necessary.
You will report to the PNG General Manager with line reporting to the Regional Operations Manager.
The Person
You must have a university degree in any field including business, with a good academic record.
You will ideally have up to 2 years of commercial work experience in any field, but newer graduates are also welcome to apply. An understanding of any of the following fields would be an advantage but not essential: market research, operations, information technology, project management, or human resources.
The role will suit you if you are interested in human behaviour, in learning to lead small teams of people, and logistics. You will have the following qualities:
a genuine interest in people’s views and opinions
the confidence to learn to lead teams
good communication skills and the ability to communicate with people from all walks of life
the highest level of personal integrity and honesty
a team player attitude and like working collaboratively
a quality focus
a high standard of written and spoken English
Details
Salary and benefits are commensurate with skills and experience.

,

The Project Officer – CIRCAR supports and coordinates implementation of nature-based solution activities under the Live and Learn–CIRCAR project. The role ensures that nature-based solution activities are effectively implemented with the grey solutions implemented by the ARUP, TSSP and Department of Works and Highways across project communities along the Markham highway in Lae, Morobe Province and particularly children and youth, are empowered to participate in consultation regarding which nature-based solution is practical. Position: PC/Network Technician
Job Summary:
In this role, you'll be responsible in providing technical support for hardware, software, and networks, including diagnosing, troubleshooting, upgrades, installations, and device setups. Excellent customer service and communication skills

Self-motivated, dependable, and able to manage time efficiently

jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our Commercial team, you will support the Materials Team Lead with all K92 Mining import/export cargo movements to site, whilst assisting in facilitating payments to freight companies by correctly processing all necessary documentation. You will work to minimize the impact of the section on the environment and ensure the workplace health & safety of employees, contractors and other stakeholders are maintained.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position mean you will
Ensure the prompt delivery arrangements for all import / export freight as required
Achieve weekly and daily priorities, and report on activity and outcomes
Ensure that all aspects of Material movements are undertaken in accordance with established policy and procedures. Ensuring that safety is paramount to all tasks performed.
Assist the Logistics Team Lead to Investigate discrepancies and incidents.
Ensure the timely completion of all tasks
Register completion of materials to Kumian Site and Port warehouse ensuring conformation that deliveries are completed to the K92 Mine schedules and plans.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you have the following
Understanding of Pronto to support logistics requirements
Experience with storage and handling of Dangerous goods
Experience in Microsoft suite office tools – Excel, Word
Class 6 License minimum
RII or Proven VOC for forklift operations
High problem-solving capability
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to communicate clearly with people at all levels of the organisation and engage all relevant stakeholders
Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in logistics industry with relevant experience within material shipping and logistics
Minimum 3-5yrs driving and operating experience
Mining Industry experience preferred.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
